title: On polyharmonic Kirchhoff double phase problems without AR-conditions
summary: In this paper, we study a class of polyharmonic Kirchhoff problems driven by a double phase operator. The reaction term has subcritical growth but does not satisfy the Ambrosetti--Rabinowitz condition. Motivated by the work of Harrabi-Hamdani-Fiscella \cite{Harrabi-Hamdani-Fiscella-2024} on m-polyharmonic Kirchhoff problems without Ambrosetti--Rabinowitz conditions, we extend their analysis to a nonhomogeneous double phase setting.
